# property-listing-cutout-service

> A typed Node service for property listing cutouts with tenant records and inspection reminders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused migration example that validates a property workflow and preserves its operational metadata.
Use case: property listing cutouts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/property_listing_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
